title: Bedmate
summary: BED'MATE, noun [bed and mate.] A bedfellow. BED'-MOLDING, [bed and molding.] In architecture, the members of a cornice, which are placed below the coronet, consisting of an ogee, a list, a large boult

inlines.v: BED'MATE, noun [bed and mate.] A bedfellow. BED'-MOLDING, [bed and molding.] In architecture, the members of a cornice, which are placed below the coronet, consisting of an ogee, a list, a large boultine, and another list under the coronet.
